chunks: And from him, from Muʿāwiyah ibn Ḥukaym, from ʿAbd Allah ibn al-Mughīrah, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-ʿAlāʾ, from Abī ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام, concerning:
Regarding the menstruating woman: one may drink from her leftover water, but wudu (ablution) is not performed from it.

key_terms.سُؤْرِهَا: her leftover water or drink residue

ai.seo_question: Can one drink from the leftover water of a menstruating woman or use it for wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the leftover water of a menstruating woman. It states that drinking from it is permissible, while using it for wudu (ablution) is not permitted.
